baseline.gpu_name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti Laptop GPU
baseline.kernel_resources_note: CUDA Driver function attributes after PTX JIT. Local-memory size can include stack, spills and compiler-managed arrays; it does not measure executed spill traffic or achieved occupancy.

profile.timing_note: Profiling runs execute after uninstrumented timing. Two timing events bracket each dispatch on the same stream; only the final sequence event is synchronized. Event and submission overhead can perturb short kernels. These are elapsed intervals, not hardware cycle, occupancy, bank-conflict or bandwidth counters. Use gpu_dispatch_ms for uninstrumented sequence comparisons.
